response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled man named THOMAS (he).

KING
(to Thomas)
I have a vision, Thomas. A vision of a new era for our kingdom. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

THOMAS
(confused)
Futurism, sire?

KING
(nodding)
Yes, yes. We must shed our medieval ways and embrace the sleek, the modern, the... the... (he gestures dramatically)...the vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in the most outlandish, futuristic attire. They are all staring at a large, glowing screen displaying a never-ending loop of distorted, VHS-style footage of medieval castles, knights, and peasants.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must infuse our aesthetic with the essence of vaporwave. The soft focus, the pastel colors, the... the... (he searches for the right words)...the nostalgia-tinged futurism.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The buildings are now covered in neon lights, and the streets are filled with strange, futuristic contraptions. Knights are now riding hoverbikes, and peasants are wearing VR headsets.

KING
(to Thomas)
Behold, Thomas! Our kingdom is now a true marvel of the modern age.

THOMAS
(stunned)
Sire, I... I don't know what to say.

KING
(laughing)
Say nothing, Thomas. Just marvel at the beauty of our new aesthetic.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is now surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in the most outlandish, futuristic attire. They are all staring at a large, glowing screen displaying a never-ending loop of distorted, VHS-style footage of medieval castles, knights, and peasants.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must continue to push the boundaries of vaporwave. We must create a new language, a new dialect, a new... a new... (he searches for the right words)...a new way of seeing the world.

COURTIER 1 (he)
Sire, I think I understand. You want us to create a new kind of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of medieval-futurism.

KING
(nodding)
Yes, yes. That is exactly what I mean.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a true marvel of the modern age. The king is riding a hoverbike, surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are wearing VR headsets and looking like they are in a trance.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We are the pioneers of a new era, my friends. An era of vaporwave-fueled progress.

COURTIER 2 (she)
Sire, I think we are making great progress.

KING
(smiling)
I couldn't agree more, my dear. We are creating a new world, a world of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of vaporwave-fueled wonder.

FADE TO BLACK.
